dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a high-degree curvature spline extending from the posterior base to the sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius, indicating a narrow, slightly rounded tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately steep linear ascent at approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum basal pixel width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine linear striae on the lateral surface of the dorsal fin and a minor irregular notch on the lower trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive mottled/patchy light-gray depigmentation across the primary dark-gray epidermal surface.
